# Units allowed to be failed in the qualification VM (qualify.sh), one unit name per
# line; '#' starts a comment. `systemctl is-system-running` may report "degraded" only
# when every failed unit is listed here. Each entry needs a reason, and the list should
# only shrink: a unit that fails in the VM usually fails on the laptop too.
#
# The VM (QEMU q35, OVMF, virtio disk/net/gpu, no sound card, no fingerprint reader,
# no battery) is not the M7400QC, so hardware units that fail only for lack of their
# device may be listed. None is needed so far.
